products.name: Newsela
products.note: Verified in the research for The AI Ready School. AI: Leveled texts, quizzes. Use: Leveled news and content at five reading levels. Who: Teachers, students. Student age: Under 13 only through a student account provided by a teacher, parent, or administrator. Privacy: Signed agreements appear in the Student Data Privacy Consortium registry (Erie 1 BOCES, New York). Price: Newsela Lite free with limited content; district pricing on request.
